skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Restores an ally’s HP by 150% ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Consumes no Energy. Applies [Fear] to all enemies, sealing 2 Energy for 1 round. Reduces [Resilience/Tenacity] of the 3 enemies with the highest HP by 40%. Restores HP to the 2 allies with the lowest HP by 300% of their ATK.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Consumes no Energy. Applies [Fear] to all enemies, sealing 3 Energy for 1 round. Reduces [Resilience/Tenacity] of all enemies by 50%. Restores HP to the 4 allies with the lowest HP by 300% of their ATK.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Increases the SPD of allies in the same row by 90% of King’s SPD. This effect remains active even if King is defeated.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own SPD by 16%. Increases the SPD of allies in the same row by 90% of King’s SPD. This effect remains active even if King is defeated.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own SPD by 20%. Increases the SPD of allies in the same row by 95% of King’s SPD. This effect remains active even if King is defeated.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, summons 1 [Drone]. The Drone inherits ATK equal to 100% of King’s ATK and HP equal to 800% of King’s ATK. The Drone absorbs 90% of all types of DMG received by King, excluding Emblem DMG and reflected DMG, until the Drone’s HP is reduced to 1%. After an ally acts, the Drone performs a [Follow-Up] against 1 random enemy, dealing 350% ATK DMG. Can trigger up to 2 times per round.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, summons 2 [Drones]. Each Drone inherits ATK equal to 100% of King’s ATK and HP equal to 800% of King’s ATK. The Drones absorb 90% of all types of DMG received by King, excluding Emblem DMG and reflected DMG, until their HP is reduced to 1%. After an ally acts, the Drones perform a [Follow-Up] against 1 random enemy, dealing 350% ATK DMG. Can trigger up to 2 times per round.

effects.desc: Seals a specified amount of the enemy team’s Energy for 1 round.
A defensive value reduced by King’s Ultimate.
A summoned unit that inherits stats from King, absorbs most incoming DMG for King, and performs Follow-Up attacks after allies act.
An additional attack triggered after an ally acts. King’s Drone targets 1 random enemy and deals 350% ATK DMG.
